name: Happy Live, Show Up: Encore!!
original_name: ハッピーライヴ ショウアップ アンコール！！
source:
Akito, the main character, visits the land where he used to live in order to meet Miyabi, who has been in a long-distance relationship. It brings about an unexpected change of heart and greatly changes the destinies of the two. The main story is a close-up after story of Miyabi Asahina, and the mini-story of Sophia, Katya, Lou, Clarisse, and Pechica & co. are also included!

[from [url=https://www.metacritic.com/game/happy-live-show-up-encore/details/]Metacritic[/url]]
